verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence mentions a JetBrains plugin or any IDE extension that shows interactive diffs. The 'Add to AI chat' code-selection feature (cubic-docs-10) and the diff view appear to live in cubic's own web review UI, not inside a JetBrains IDE, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. The documented local tools are a CLI and an MCP server, neither of which is a JetBrains integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
